Natural Fiber Innovation and Sustainable Textile Solutions # HerMin Textile is dedicated to advancing the textile industry through a commitment to sustainability, innovation, and quality. Rooted in a strong heritage and guided by a forward-thinking philosophy, the company continually seeks to bridge the gap between functionality and environmental responsibility.
Sustainable Philosophy # HerMin Textile upholds the founder’s vision by relentlessly pursuing the creation of environmentally friendly yet highly functional fabrics. The company prioritizes the use of all-natural materials in its weaving processes and actively explores new sources for eco-friendly solutions. Significant resources are allocated to both the R&D and design teams, fueling a culture of innovation.
A recent initiative, “The Natural Laboratory,” focuses on the science of bionics to transfer functional attributes into natural or sustainable fibers. Notable developments include Cotton Shell®, a 100% organic waterproof cotton fabric, and Cotton Down®, a 100% organic down-proof cotton fabric—both of which are PFC-free. HerMin’s mission is to optimize the balance between functionality and sustainability, striving for their coexistence in every product.
Download Our Company Profile
Heritage and Evolution # Founded in 1976 by Mr. Chen Wen-Jin, HerMin Textile Co., LTD emerged during Taiwan’s economic transformation and the rise of the export market. The Tainan plant initially specialized in woven plaid fabrics, primarily using natural fibers such as cotton, silk, linen, and wool. To address market challenges and price competition, HerMin shifted its focus to developing natural fiber fabrics with added value.
In recent years, the company’s R&D efforts have concentrated on functional and sustainable research, ensuring superior product performance and enabling clients to tell better stories through their offerings.
Innovation in Research and Development # HerMin’s R&D team collaborates with fiber and finishing agent companies worldwide—including partners in Switzerland, Italy, Germany, Japan, the USA, and Taiwan—to discover and implement the latest and best solutions. The in-house laboratory rigorously tests various yarns, weaving techniques, and chemical combinations to achieve optimal performance. By leveraging the strengths of Taiwan’s synthetic fabrics and infusing them with the tactile qualities of natural fibers, HerMin offers versatility and positions itself as a solution provider for clients.
Fashion-Forward Design # The design team at HerMin works closely with Italian trend forecasting companies and textile consultants to stay aligned with upcoming fashion trends. Each season, the team develops new patterns and woven constructions to inspire clients. Professional CAD design services are available on demand, along with expert advice on fashion colors. The latest Penelope CAD software enables hyper-realistic fabric simulations, streamlining the pattern decision-making process for clients.
Tailor-Made Services # For Innovators # HerMin welcomes challenges and has conducted thousands of trials on new materials and chemicals to meet client needs. The company collaborates with innovative brands and crowdfunding projects to develop exclusive fabrics, offering low minimum order quantity (MOQ) services to ensure new developments are refined to perfection.
For Fashionistas # With deep expertise, HerMin transforms concepts into tangible products, understanding both market demands and the requirements for product success. Clients receive the latest information on fabric specifications, color trends, weave trends, and print trends. HerMin’s tailor-made approach ensures that ideas are seamlessly translated into high-quality products for any end-use application.
Functional Capabilities # HerMin’s fabrics are engineered to deliver a wide range of functional benefits, including:
Easy care Wrinkle-free Double-weave Anti-bacterial Respiration Comfort retention Color stability (stay white) Anti-odor Stretch and bi-stretch Memory fabric easy care wrinkle-free double-weave anti-bacterial anti-bacterial respiration stay comfort stay white antiodor stretch memory fabric bi-stretch

Flexible and Ethical Garment Manufacturing for Brands of All Sizes # Hermin Textile offers a full spectrum of garment manufacturing services, designed to support both emerging and established brands. With a focus on flexibility, innovation, and sustainability, our solutions are tailored to meet the diverse needs of the apparel industry.
Why Choose Hermin Textile for Garment Manufacturing? # Flexible Order Quantities
We accommodate low minimum order quantities, starting from just 100 pieces per style. For larger orders, attractive pricing tiers are available, making it easier to scale your collection while optimizing costs. Entrusting your entire collection to us streamlines your sourcing and production, freeing up your time for branding and marketing.
Fabric Innovation and Quality
As a manufacturer for many top global brands, we are recognized for our product innovation and quality. Our extensive range of fabrics includes eco-friendly, recycled, and high-performance textiles. See our client list.
Ethical and Sustainable Practices
All workers are paid above the national minimum wage. Our factory is certified by Oeko-Tex 100 and GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard), and we use GRS (Global Recycle Standard) certified yarns. We uphold a zero recruitment fee policy for migrant workers, ensuring fair and ethical labor practices. GOTS Global Organic Textile Standard OEKO-TEX® Standard 100 Product Categories # Urban Outdoor Active Wear Bags Fashion Casual Business The Advantage of Manufacturing in Taiwan # Taiwan is renowned for its functional textiles, supplying over 70% of the world’s functional fabrics for global brands. By manufacturing garments in Taiwan, you benefit from reduced carbon footprint and streamlined logistics, as both fabric and garment production are consolidated in one location.
Our Manufacturing Capabilities # Outerwear Shirting Bottoms Knits Bags Others Collaboration Models # We understand that every brand is unique, so we offer several ways to collaborate:
Sample and Graded Pattern Provided
If you supply a sample and graded pattern, we charge a sample fee starting from $30 USD, depending on style complexity.
Sketch or Sample Provided, No Pattern
If you provide only a sketch or sample, please include a size chart or a reference garment. Pattern and sampling fees start from $80 USD.
Design Concept Only
For clients needing design assistance, we offer ODM services to bring your concepts to life. Design, pattern, and sample fees apply, with quotes provided after consultation.
Pattern and sample fees can be waived for bulk orders of 300 pieces or more per style. Design service fees are not waivable. Due to high demand, patterns and samples are only created for confirmed production orders.
Typical Workflow # Fabric Selection
Our representatives help you choose the most suitable fabrics for your products. Patterning and Sampling
After fabric selection, we proceed with pattern making and sample development. Customization
Discuss additional design elements such as embroidery or printing. Learn more. Pattern Grading
Once samples are approved, we provide free pattern grading for production orders. Bulk Production
Upon approval, we move to bulk production. Lead times vary based on fabric and style complexity: Fabric with greige available (dyeing/printing): 30 days Fabrics from scratch: 60 days Production: 30-60 days Recommended planning: 5-6 months before collection launch Quality Control and Shipment
Rigorous quality control is conducted before packing and shipping according to your instructions. Frequently Asked Questions # Q1: What is your standard MOQ?
A1: For available stock fabrics, MOQ is 100 pieces. Orders of 50 pieces are possible but cost 50-60% more per piece.
Q2: What are sample and production lead times?
A2: Sampling takes 2-4 weeks, depending on style and capacity. Bulk production typically takes 3-8 weeks.

A3: Yes, we offer ODM and FPP (Fully Packaged Product) services. Costs depend on requirements. Contact us for a quote.
Q4: Can I use existing patterns and just change the print?
A4: For basic items like T-shirts, polo shirts, joggers, shirts, and hoodies, existing patterns are available. For complex products, patterns are custom-made for each client.

Sustainable Textile Solutions for Modern Applications # Sustainability is at the core of our textile development, spanning from the selection of yarns to the final finishing processes. Our collection features a diverse array of eco-friendly fabrics and advanced technologies, designed to meet the needs of modern apparel and performance markets while minimizing environmental impact.
Eco-Friendly Fabric Collection # Our range incorporates a variety of sustainable materials, including premium organic cotton, recycled nylon, recycled polyester, and polypropylene (PP). These fabrics can be further enhanced with eco-functional finishes, providing both environmental benefits and high performance.
Key Eco Materials # Recycled Polyester Fabric
Billions of PET bottles are discarded annually. We transform these bottles into high-quality yarns, available in multiple counts for versatile applications.
Recycled Nylon Fabric
Sourced from process waste and recycled fishing nets, this material offers a sustainable alternative to conventional nylon.
Polypropylene Fabric
Utilizing solution-dyed and dyeable Cool Vision(R) yarn, this fabric is lighter than water and highly sustainable.
Tencel Fabric
Produced in a Lenzing-certified mill, our Tencel fabrics are suitable for various uses, with a signature down-proof item that requires no coating or membrane.
BCI Cotton Fabric
Sourced from top-quality organic cotton, ensuring both sustainability and comfort.
Organic Cotton Linen Fabric
Available in pure and blended forms, these fabrics offer quick-dry and anti-odor properties.
Abaca Fabric
Made from paper yarn derived from Abaca in the Philippines, this fabric grows without chemical treatments or pesticides, featuring a natural dry touch and quick-dry properties.
Organic Cotton Wool Fabric
Delivers a viyella-like handfeel with functional eco finishes, ideal for winter shirting and outerwear.
Hermin Recycle Polyester Yarns Hermin Recycle Nylon Fabric Hermin Polypropylene Fabrics Hermin Tencel Fabrics Hermin Eco Friendly Organic Cotton Fabric Hermin Pure Linen Fabric Supplier Hermin Abaca Fabric Supplier Hermin Non-Mulesing Wool Fabrics Sustainable Membrane Technologies # To address the demands of outdoor and performance applications, we offer a selection of environmentally friendly bonded membrane products:
Susterra Membrane Fabric
A bio-based polyurethane derived from corn, this lightweight and breathable membrane is suitable for two- and three-layer constructions, making it an excellent sustainable choice for outerwear.
Recyclable Nylon Membrane Fabric
Made from 100% nylon, this membrane enables full garment recyclability when paired with single-component nylon fabrics, achieving up to 10K/10K performance.
Xpore Fabric
Featuring an ultra-thin membrane with 10 billion nanopores per square inch, Xpore blocks rain while allowing vapor and airflow, making it ideal for high-performance outerwear.
Susterra Membranes Recyclable Nylon Membrane Xpore Fabric Sustainable Coating Solutions # Beewax Coated Fabric
Utilizing pure, unbleached organic bee wax imported from Germany, this coating is excellent for jackets and bags, achieving waterproofness up to 1000mm. Sustainable Stretch Fabrics # Lycra T-166L Fabric
Cradle to Cradle Certified®, this is a sustainable solution for stretch materials.
Sorona Stretch Fabric
Composed of 37% plant-based content, Sorona uses 30% less energy and emits 50% fewer greenhouse gases than traditional nylon.
Lycra T400 EcoMade Fabric
A spandex-free stretch option made with 68% sustainable resources, offering superior recovery and quick-dry properties, qualifying for COOLMAX® marketing.
T-166L Lycra Sorona R Lycra T400 EcoMade Fabric Eco-Conscious Processes & Finishing # We are committed to ongoing research and investment in reducing our ecological footprint. By adopting innovative dyeing and finishing techniques, we have significantly decreased water and electricity consumption in our manufacturing processes.
For more information on our sustainable fabric solutions and to explore our full product range, visit our Eco Friendly Fabric page.

Sustainable Knitted Textiles: Materials, Structures, and Applications # Hermin’s knitted textiles are designed to combine innovative structures with sustainable materials, offering versatile solutions for both indoor and outdoor activities. Our range includes options such as organic cotton, Tencel®, recycled polyester, recycled nylon, and more. Whether you are seeking fabrics for activewear, casual wear, or specialized applications, our knitted textiles are engineered to meet diverse needs. Additionally, we offer a variety of eco-functional finishes to further enhance performance and sustainability.
Categories of Knitted Fabric # Intimacy / Underwear Yoga / Athleisure Golf / Urban Outdoor Casual / Streetwear Types of Knitted Fabrics # Single Jersey Fabric # Single jersey is a weft-knitted fabric produced with a single row of needles, resulting in a single-layer structure. This fabric is known for its stretch, softness, and comfort, making it ideal for underwear, t-shirts, and tops.
Interlock Fabric # Interlock fabric is a double-knitted textile, offering greater thickness, stretch, strength, and durability compared to single jersey. Despite its firm construction, it maintains a soft and smooth texture. Common uses include pants, yoga leggings, and dresses.
French Terry # French terry features soft loops on the inside and a smooth exterior. With a warm and soft texture, it ranges from medium to heavy weight and is widely used for sweatshirts, joggers, and loungewear.
Jacquard # Jacquard fabrics are produced using computer-controlled techniques to create a variety of patterns, making them suitable for sportswear and swimwear.
Warp Knitted Fabric # Warp knitted fabrics are produced at continuous widths using multiple threads, resulting in a more complex and robust structure compared to weft knits. These fabrics are manufactured quickly and in larger sizes, offering enhanced strength.
Key Features and Applications # Intimacy / Underwear # For intimacy and underwear, anti-bacterial and anti-odor properties are prioritized. Common materials include polyester spandex, nylon spandex, and Lycra, as well as natural options like cotton, Tencel®, and Umorfil®, which are beneficial for both comfort and the environment.
Read more
Yoga / Athleisure # Yoga and athleisure fabrics emphasize flexibility, durability, and stretch. Materials range from organic cotton, Tencel®, and Lyocell to recycled polyester spandex, nylon spandex, and Lycra®. Functional finishes such as cooling, wicking, and anti-bacterial treatments are often applied.
Read more
Golf / Urban Outdoor # Golf and urban outdoor fabrics focus on wicking, cooling, and anti-bacterial properties. Synthetic fibers like polyester, nylon, and Lycra are commonly used, alongside natural fibers such as cotton, Tencel®, and Lyocell for enhanced comfort.
Read more
Casual / Streetwear # Casual and streetwear fabrics prioritize natural feel and comfort. Lightweight fabrics are chosen for loungewear, while heavier options are used for streetwear. Fleece finishes can add softness and warmth.
Read more

Advancing Sustainable Functional Textiles # Founded in 1976, HerMin Textile is dedicated to the continuous pursuit of sustainable and functional fabric innovation. Guided by the founder’s vision, the company has developed the “Natural Laboratory” project, focusing on pushing the boundaries of natural fibers and integrating advanced functionality into eco-friendly textiles.
Our Approach to Sustainability and Functionality # HerMin Textile is committed to transferring functional attributes into natural fabrics in the most sustainable way possible. The company’s proprietary BNS Bouncy Technology enables Cotton, Tencel®, and Modal® fabrics to achieve stretchability without the use of Lycra® or spandex. This innovation results in 100% pure cotton fabrics that are biodegradable and have a reduced environmental impact compared to synthetic stretch fibers.
Additionally, the EZ Dye Technology developed by HerMin saves over 80% of steam and water, 70% of alkali and salt, and at least 50% of dyestuff during the dyeing process, further minimizing environmental footprint.

Custom Garment Manufacturing: From design to production, ensuring quality at every step. Knit Fabric: Functional and innovative sustainable fabrics for both indoor and outdoor activities. Apparel Fabric: Yarn/piece dye, dobby, jacquard, and more. Non Apparel Fabric: Solutions for non-apparel applications. Fast Delivery Fabric: Quick turnaround for urgent needs. Bonded/Lamination Fabrics: Advanced bonding and lamination options. Bouncy Cotton: Natural Stretch Without Elastane # Bouncy Cotton is a breakthrough in textile technology, offering pure cotton fabrics with stretch properties, without any elastane, spandex, or Lycra. Both woven and knit options are available, making them suitable for a wide range of applications. These fabrics are 100% biodegradable and compatible with all cotton yarns, providing an environmentally friendly alternative to synthetic stretch fibers.

content:
Commitment to Sustainable and Functional Textile Innovation # HerMin Textile is dedicated to upholding the vision of its founder by relentlessly pursuing the creation of environmentally friendly and highly functional fabrics. Our philosophy centers on the harmonious coexistence of sustainability and performance, driving us to continually seek new sources of eco-friendly solutions and invest in research and development.
Advancing Sustainability and Functionality # We are committed to sourcing all-natural materials for our weaving processes, while also exploring innovative, environmentally responsible alternatives. Significant resources are allocated to our R&D and design teams, fueling the development of new products and solutions. One of our latest initiatives, “The Natural Laboratory,” focuses on the science of bionics, enabling us to transfer functional attributes into natural or sustainable fibers.
Recent advancements include the introduction of Cotton Shell®, a 100% organic waterproof cotton fabric, and Cotton Down®, a 100% organic down-proof cotton fabric. Both are PFC-free, reflecting our commitment to safer, more sustainable textiles. Our mission is to bridge the gap between functionality and sustainability, ensuring that our products deliver both high performance and environmental responsibility.
Heritage and Evolution # Founded in 1976 by Mr. Chen Wen-Jin, HerMin Textile Co., LTD emerged during a pivotal period in Taiwan’s economic transformation. Initially, our Tainan plant specialized in producing woven plaid fabrics using primarily natural fibers such as cotton, with silk, linen, and wool also featured. As market dynamics shifted and price competition intensified, we responded by developing natural fiber fabrics with enhanced value.
In recent years, our focus has shifted toward functional and sustainable research, ensuring that our products not only perform better but also help our clients tell compelling stories about quality and responsibility.
Innovation at the Core # Our R&D team collaborates with fiber and finishing agent companies worldwide, including partners in Switzerland, Italy, Germany, Japan, the USA, and Taiwan. This global network allows us to identify and implement the latest and most effective solutions. We rigorously test various yarns, weaving techniques, and chemical combinations in our in-house laboratory to achieve optimal performance. By leveraging the strengths of Taiwan’s synthetic fabrics and infusing them with the tactile qualities of natural fibers, we offer unmatched versatility and serve as a comprehensive solution provider for our clients.
Fashion-Forward Design # Our design team works closely with Italian trend forecasting agencies and textile consultants to stay aligned with emerging fashion trends. Each season, we develop a range of new patterns and woven constructions to inspire our clients. We offer professional CAD design services and provide guidance on fabric specifications, color trends, weave trends, and print trends. Our latest Penelope CAD software delivers hyper-realistic fabric simulations, streamlining the pattern selection process for our clients.
Tailor-Made Services # For Innovators # We embrace challenges and have conducted thousands of trials with new materials and chemicals to meet the unique needs of our clients. Our collaborations with innovative brands and crowdfunding projects have resulted in exclusive, custom-developed fabrics. To support experimentation and refinement, we offer low minimum order quantity (MOQ) services, ensuring that new fabrics are perfected before full-scale production. Contact us to discuss your ideas.
Best Natural Fiber Fabric Manufacturer for Innovators For Fashionistas # With our expertise, we transform your concepts into tangible products that meet market demands and set trends. We provide the latest fashion intelligence, including fabric specifications, color and weave trends, and print directions. Our tailor-made approach ensures that your ideas are realized in the highest quality products for your intended application. Contact us to start your project.

Easy care Wrinkle-free Double-weave Anti-bacterial Respiration Comfort retention Whiteness retention Anti-odor Stretch Memory fabric Bi-stretch These features are the result of our ongoing commitment to innovation and quality, ensuring that our clients receive fabrics that meet the highest standards of performance and sustainability.

content:
Exploring Textile Heritage and Sustainable Innovation # Hermin Textile Museum (HMTM) # In 2014, HerMin undertook a significant transformation by revamping its former greige storage facility at the Tainan Qi-Gu Factory into the Hermin Textile Museum (HMTM). This museum offers visitors an immersive experience into the entire process of fabric production, from raw material to finished textile. The museum is designed to showcase HerMin’s rich yarn dye heritage, presenting vibrant and creative fabric displays that aim to inspire and educate every guest. In addition to the exhibits, the museum hosts a variety of engaging textile-related DIY classes, providing hands-on opportunities to explore the world of textiles. For further details, visit https://hmtm.hermin.com.tw.
Banantex®: Pioneering Sustainable Fabric # Banantex® stands as the world’s first durable, waterproof fabric crafted entirely from banana plants. Sourced from the Philippines, these banana plants are cultivated within a natural ecosystem that supports sustainable forestry, requiring no chemical treatments. This self-sustaining crop has played a vital role in reforesting areas previously degraded by palm plantations, while also contributing to the economic well-being of local farmers. After three years of dedicated research and development, Banantex® emerged as a material that addresses environmental, economic, and social sustainability challenges. To learn more, visit https://www.bananatex.info/.
